primary_contrast.endpoint: equal-task macro mean paired score difference, percentage points
primary_contrast.method: resample target-document groups with replacement independently within each task; retain all examples within each selected group; equal weight task means
primary_contrast.interpretation: Preregistered quality contrast under disclosed unequal cache geometry; not a SOTA or equal-physical-memory test

resource_scope: 1024-hot and992+32-attended panels reuse same freshly generated control records. Label configured vs observed width, full-cache unrestricted, faithfulSnap unequal expanded/growing resources. No full-memory equality claim.
limitations: Serialized all-logits-finite and hooks-restored flags are verified assertions from runtime; this verifier does not replay model forward calls.
Existing controls labeled adapted remain adaptations; faithful SnapKV has expanded and growing KV resources.
Full population is descriptive and includes consumed examples; recorded-use partitions do not prove absence of unrecorded or training exposure.
Quality run does not verify distinct latency, physical STT-RAM, context-scaling or headroom experiments.
